bio: Located in the Haus für Kultur und Sport, in a quiet yet easily accessible area in Schwalbach-Hülzweiler, this restaurant is very popular. The interior with modern lines is tastefully decorated in a palette of calm, cheerful colours, and the broad, glazed façade means the space is lovely and bright. The seasonal and Mediterranean-inspired food is cooked meticulously and with attention to detail. The excellent à la carte selection ranges from beef carpaccio to truffle pasta and fried halibut. There is also a children's menu. Attentive service with a personal touch comes courtesy of the competent team....
